facts.business: Zydus Wellness Limited develops, manufactures, markets and distributes differentiated health and wellness products across healthcare, nutrition and cosmeceutical categories.
key_risks: Impairment risk on goodwill of Rs 1,133 million relating to Consumer Health & Wellness CGU
Dependence on key assumptions for impairment testing including forecast revenues, operating margins, growth rate, terminal values and discount rate
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured loan from fellow subsidiary Zydus Healthcare Limited of Rs 350 million outstanding as at March 31, 2025 (nil as at March 31, 2026). Interest at Treasury Bill plus margin, repayable within 1 year.
